title: Sic 'Em
description: Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy this turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]3[/blue].
smart_description: Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy this turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
notes: Applied to enemies by Osty. Triggers whenever Osty attacks the affected enemy, incrementing the counter and summoning creatures. Removes itself at the end of the turn.
